title: Filter scoped salesman evidence and summaries by employee name
description: Users find an assigned salesman by a literal employee-name keyword in the existing field designer instead of knowing an employee ID. Extend existing SalesmanOutputFilterDto with optional trimmed name keyword, blank=absent, at most 80 characters, reject control characters and invalid lengths before source reads. Reuse one normalization rule for source service/catalog/preview/detail Excel/detail PDF/summary Excel/summary PDF. Intersect keyword with existing customer scope and customer/salesman/currency/date/status predicates before the 501-order cap using an EF-translatable correlated BaseEmployees.Any predicate for persisted SalesmanId with nondeleted employee and literal EmployeeName.Contains; no separate broad employee directory or client identity authority. Percent/underscore are literal text, not SQL wildcard instructions; matching follows existing database collation, do not promise case-insensitive normalization. Missing/deleted employee names do not match nonblank keyword; omitted keyword retains existing unknown-identity rows. No extra employee/source N+1 reads. Catalog describes finite keyword ability, normalized context propagated in preview/all downloads even salesman field hidden; UI preserves keyword across pagination/download/error and resets page on change, escapes text/Excel/PDF context. Verify scope intersection, invalid input, matching before cap, unknown-identity defaults, literal metacharacters, both summary and detail downloads; check generated SQL translation offline without database connection if feasible, otherwise mark external provider acceptance blocked, never claim real database passed. Development only: reuse the existing salesman-output menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted assigned-salesman SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Every endpoint validates current requests and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope, rejecting invalid/revoked/500-order-cap overflow without data/file. Employee filters never broaden ERP permissions. Evidence remains assigned approved sales orders, not all ERP orders, production, actual revenue/shipment/receipts. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Validated optional literal employee-name keyword intersects current scope and existing filters in the EF source before cap probes; no directory leak, arbitrary SQL or expanded permission, with omitted-keyword compatibility.
Catalog/preview/designer and all detail/summary Excel/PDF requests preserve the same normalized keyword context and safe page-reset/error state, with formula/HTML/PDF-safe labels.

Focused service/API/export/UI tests cover invalid/blank keywords, scope revocation, missing/deleted employee names, literal wildcard characters and filtering before caps; offline query translation where feasible and safe Release build/test pass.
